connector.name: Peil
connector.registryDescription: Log hours, draft invoices and check where you stand - finance for Dutch freelancers.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package peil-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.peil, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PEIL_API_KEY
env.description: Scoped API key from Peil under Settings -> Developer settings (Pro).

env.name: PEIL_API_URL
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.peil.app/api/v1.
